Evan (Support): Heads-up: BlueVine Labs onboarding blocked during final validation. Two separate failures: (1) provisioning halted by a data-residency policy mismatch (provisioning API returning 403 for region EU-GOV); (2) search returns garbled results after ingest — indexer logs show `decode_error: invalid_base64_payload`. Renewal in ~30 days. Can CS take this as a priority escalation? INC-7842 https://tickets.internal/INC-7842 :bangbang:
Maya (CSM): Acknowledged. Is this affecting prod or just sandbox? Need a short impact blurb for account health and renewal tracker.
Evan (Support): Sandbox only but customer uses sandbox to certify compliance. Provisioning blocked when tenant attempted EU-GOV region; logs: `policy: residency_violation tenant=bluevine region=eu-gov status=403`. Embed pipeline failure: their partner uploaded gzipped payloads but our ingestion expects base64 JSON — looks like a client mismatch.
Jon (CS Ops): Splitting owners: provisioning/policy -> Eng, ingest/migration -> CS Ops. I can own the reprocess and build a safe conversion job if CS wants to lead comms. Estimate backfill 3-6h depending on size.
Maya (CSM): I'll own comms and renewal risk. @Priya can eng review the residency policy block? We may need a short-term exception while we align configs.
Priya (Eng): Quick triage: policy engine rejected the tenant because the account-level `data_residency` flag is missing while the requested region is EU-GOV. Two mitigation options: (A) set tenant flag to `eu-gov` (ops toggle) to allow provisioning in that region if customer confirms, or (B) move sandbox to allowed region and re-run onboarding. I can add a tenant-scoped ops command: `PATCH https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/bluevine -d '{"data_residency":"eu-gov"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops>"`. Owner: Eng. ETA for stopgap ~30-60m after approval. Longer-term: change validation to surface clearer error and add self-serve region guidance.
Evan (Support): INC-7842 updated with sanitised logs and sample payloads. ticket-bot: status -> escalated to CS + eng.
Maya (CSM): Draft customer note: "Hi Jorge — we're investigating two issues that blocked your final validation: (1) a residency configuration mismatch preventing provisioning into EU-GOV; (2) a payload format mismatch causing index errors. Short-term: we can either temporarily enable EU-GOV for your tenant (pending your confirmation) or move the sandbox to an alternate region while we update onboarding docs. For search we will run a conversion job to normalize uploaded payloads and reindex. Expected stopgap ETA 1h; reindex ETA 3-6h. Can we schedule a 20m sync in the next 45m?" Thoughts?
Lena (Renewals): Please capture renewal risk: if provisioning isn't complete within 7 days, consider escalation to AE. For now mark renewal risk = Elevated. Add a line to the renewal tracker.
Jon (CS Ops): For ingest: I'll provide a safe-convert script: `curl -XPOST https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/bluevine/actions/convert_ingest -d '{"migration":"gzip->jsonb64","batch":500}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops>"`. That will detect gzipped objects, decompress, base64-encode JSON and requeue for indexing. I'll also prepare a one-click job link.
Priya (Eng): If customer approves tenant flag change, ops command to set residency: `PATCH https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/bluevine -d '{"data_residency":"eu-gov"}'`. I'll only do this after written customer confirmation and thumb from security.
Maya (CSM): Internal comms plan (short):
- Immediate: Option A) Enable tenant EU-GOV flag (ops) after customer confirmation OR Option B) move sandbox to an approved region (CS Ops)  owner: Eng/CS Ops  ETA: 30-60m
- Short-term: Run conversion + reindex job for corrupted payloads  owner: CS Ops (Jon)  ETA: 3-6h (can be overnight)
- Customer sync: 20m within 45m  owner: CSM (Maya)
- Renewal note: Lena to update tracker (risk = Elevated)
Maya (CSM): I'll send the customer note asking for residency confirmation and schedule the 20m sync at 10:20am PT. @Evan attach the sanitized logs and @Jon share the one-click job when ready.
Evan (Support): Attached logs and sample uploaded object (sanitised). :white_check_mark:
ticket-bot: INC-7842 comment added by Evan: "Escalated to CS + Eng. Suspect residency flag missing + client-side gzip->base64 mismatch. Artifacts attached."
Lena (Renewals): Renewals tracker updated: BlueVine Labs  renewal status = Elevated (30d out). Will notify AE if not resolved in 7 days.
Jon (CS Ops): Building the conversion job and runbook now, sharing link in this thread in ~20m.
Priya (Eng): Please get written approval from the customer before toggling the residency flag (compliance). I'll standby for Ops run once security signs off.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. I'll own comms and follow-ups until resolved. Ping me for any regression or if customer requests rollback/alternate window.
